« depuis » + action qui continue : present perfect (have lived), jamais le présent simple.
explain.en: “Depuis” + ongoing action: present perfect (have lived), never the present simple.

question: How long ___ you known her?
fr: Depuis combien de temps la connais-tu ?

explain.fr: How long…? + situation qui dure jusqu'à maintenant : present perfect.
explain.en: How long…? + situation continuing to now: present perfect.

say: How long have you known her?

question: She ___ for two hours. She's exhausted.
fr: Elle court depuis deux heures. Elle est épuisée.

explain.fr: Activité qui dure jusqu'à maintenant : present perfect en -ing (has been + -ing).
explain.en: Activity continuing up to now: present perfect continuous (has been + -ing).

say: She has been running for two hours. She's exhausted.

question: I ___ my keys. I can't get in!
fr: J'ai perdu mes clés. Je ne peux pas entrer !

explain.fr: Action passée avec un résultat présent : present perfect.
explain.en: Past action with a present result: present perfect.

say: I have lost my keys. I can't get in!

question: I ___ my keys yesterday, but I found them this morning.
fr: J'ai perdu mes clés hier, mais je les ai retrouvées ce matin.

explain.fr: Moment précis du passé (yesterday) : prétérit.

say: I lost my keys yesterday, but I found them this morning.

question: When we got to the station, the train ___.
fr: Quand nous sommes arrivés à la gare, le train était déjà parti.

explain.fr: Action antérieure à une autre action passée : past perfect (had + participe).
explain.en: Action before another past action: past perfect (had + participle).

say: When we got to the station, the train had already left.

question: I ___ in Rome for a year when I met my wife.
fr: Je vivais à Rome depuis un an quand j'ai rencontré ma femme.

explain.fr: Durée jusqu'à un moment passé : past perfect en -ing.
explain.en: Duration up to a past moment: past perfect continuous.

say: I had been living in Rome for a year when I met my wife.

question: I ___ play tennis, but now I prefer golf.
fr: Avant, je jouais au tennis, mais maintenant je préfère le golf.

explain.fr: Habitude passée terminée : used to + verbe.
explain.en: Past habit that has stopped: used to + verb.

say: I used to play tennis, but now I prefer golf.

explain.fr: « yet » en fin de question ou de négation au present perfect.
explain.en: “Yet” at the end of questions and negatives in the present perfect.

explain.fr: « already » (déjà) dans une phrase affirmative, avant le participe.

question: This time next week, I ___ on a beach.
fr: La semaine prochaine à la même heure, je serai allongé sur une plage.

explain.fr: Action en cours à un moment futur : will be + -ing.
explain.en: Action in progress at a future time: will be + -ing.

say: This time next week, I will be lying on a beach.

question: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.
fr: S'il pleut demain, nous annulerons le pique-nique.

explain.fr: Conditionnel 1 : if + présent, will + verbe. Jamais « will » après « if ».
explain.en: First conditional: if + present, will + verb. Never “will” after “if”.

say: If it rains tomorrow, we'll cancel the picnic.

question: If I ___ rich, I would travel around the world.
fr: Si j'étais riche, je ferais le tour du monde.

explain.fr: Conditionnel 2 : if + prétérit (were pour toutes les personnes en anglais soigné), would + verbe.
explain.en: Second conditional: if + past (were for all persons in careful English), would + verb.

say: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.

question: If you ___ water to 100°C, it boils.
fr: Si on chauffe de l'eau à 100 °C, elle bout.

explain.fr: Vérité générale : if + présent, présent (conditionnel zéro).
explain.en: General truth: if + present, present (zero conditional).

say: If you heat water to 100°C, it boils.

question: What would you do if you ___ a lot of money?
fr: Que ferais-tu si tu trouvais beaucoup d'argent ?

explain.fr: Hypothèse irréelle : if + prétérit.

say: What would you do if you found a lot of money?

question: I ___ you if I had your number.
fr: Je t'appellerais si j'avais ton numéro.

explain.fr: Conditionnel 2 : would + verbe.

say: I would call you if I had your number.

question: ___ you hurry, you'll miss the train.
fr: Si tu ne te dépêches pas, tu vas rater le train.

explain.fr: « unless » = if… not (à moins que).

say: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.

question: If I were you, I ___ that job.
fr: À ta place, je prendrais ce travail.

explain.fr: Conseil : If I were you, I would…
explain.en: Advice: If I were you, I would…

say: If I were you, I would take that job.

question: This bridge ___ in 1890.
fr: Ce pont a été construit en 1890.

explain.fr: Passif au prétérit : was / were + participe passé.
explain.en: Past passive: was / were + past participle.

question: English ___ in many countries.
fr: L'anglais est parlé dans de nombreux pays.

explain.fr: Passif au présent : is / are + participe passé.
explain.en: Present passive: is / are + past participle.

say: English is spoken in many countries.

question: The letters ___ every morning.
fr: Le courrier est distribué tous les matins.

explain.fr: Sujet pluriel (letters) → are + participe.

say: The letters are delivered every morning.

question: My car ___ at the moment.
fr: Ma voiture est en réparation en ce moment.

explain.fr: Passif en cours : is being + participe.
explain.en: Passive in progress: is being + participle.

say: My car is being repaired at the moment.

question: The thief ___ by the police yesterday.
fr: Le voleur a été arrêté par la police hier.

explain.fr: Moment passé précis : passif au prétérit.
explain.en: Specific past time: past simple passive.

say: The thief was arrested by the police yesterday.

question: The museum ___ next year.
fr: Le musée sera inauguré l'année prochaine.

explain.fr: Passif au futur : will be + participe.

say: The museum will be opened next year.

question: He said that he ___ tired.
fr: Il a dit qu'il était fatigué.

explain.fr: Discours indirect au passé : présent → prétérit (concordance des temps).
explain.en: Reported speech in the past: present → past (backshift).

say: He said that he was tired.

question: She told me she ___ me the next day.
fr: Elle m'a dit qu'elle m'appellerait le lendemain.

explain.fr: will → would au discours indirect.

say: She told me she would call me the next day.

question: He asked me where I ___.

explain.fr: Question indirecte : ordre sujet + verbe, sans « did ».
explain.en: Indirect question: subject + verb order, no “did”.

say: He asked me where I lived.

question: She ___ me that she was leaving.

explain.fr: tell + personne (told me) ; say sans personne (she said that…).
explain.en: tell + person (told me); say without a person (she said that…).

say: She told me that she was leaving.

question: He ___ that he was hungry.
fr: Il a dit qu'il avait faim.

explain.fr: say + that (sans complément de personne).

say: He said that he was hungry.

question: The teacher asked us ___ quiet.
fr: Le professeur nous a demandé d'être silencieux.

explain.fr: Ordre ou demande rapportés : ask / tell + personne + to + verbe.
explain.en: Reported request: ask / tell + person + to + verb.

say: The teacher asked us to be quiet.

question: The woman ___ lives next door is a nurse.
fr: La femme qui habite à côté est infirmière.

explain.fr: Personne : who (ou that).

say: The woman who lives next door is a nurse.

question: This is the phone ___ I bought yesterday.
fr: Voici le téléphone que j'ai acheté hier.

explain.fr: Chose : which ou that.

say: This is the phone that I bought yesterday.

question: That's the man ___ car was stolen.
fr: C'est l'homme dont la voiture a été volée.

explain.fr: Possession : whose (dont le / la).

say: That's the man whose car was stolen.

question: The town ___ I was born is very small.
fr: La ville où je suis né est très petite.

explain.fr: Lieu : where.

say: The town where I was born is very small.

question: I remember the day ___ we met.
fr: Je me souviens du jour où nous nous sommes rencontrés.

explain.fr: Moment : when (« où » temporel).

say: I remember the day when we met.

question: ___ you need is a good rest.
fr: Ce dont tu as besoin, c'est d'un bon repos.

explain.fr: « ce que / ce dont » en début de phrase : What.
explain.en: “Ce que / ce dont” at the start: What.

say: What you need is a good rest.

question: I'm looking forward to ___ you.

explain.fr: look forward to + -ing (« to » est ici une préposition).
explain.en: look forward to + -ing (“to” is a preposition here).

say: I'm looking forward to seeing you.

question: He refused ___ the bill.
fr: Il a refusé de payer l'addition.

explain.fr: refuse + to + verbe.

say: He refused to pay the bill.

question: She suggested ___ to the beach.
fr: Elle a proposé d'aller à la plage.

explain.fr: suggest + -ing (ou suggest that…).

say: She suggested going to the beach.

question: I stopped ___ two years ago. I feel much better.
fr: J'ai arrêté de fumer il y a deux ans.

explain.fr: stop + -ing = arrêter une activité.

say: I stopped smoking two years ago. I feel much better.

question: On the way home, I stopped ___ some bread.
fr: En rentrant, je me suis arrêté pour acheter du pain.

explain.fr: stop + to = s'arrêter pour faire quelque chose.
explain.en: stop + to = stop in order to do something.

say: On the way home, I stopped to buy some bread.

question: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
fr: Pense à fermer la porte à clé en partant.

explain.fr: remember + to = penser à faire (dans le futur).
explain.en: remember + to = not forget to do (future).

say: Remember to lock the door when you leave.

question: I remember ___ him at a party years ago.
fr: Je me souviens de l'avoir rencontré à une fête il y a des années.

explain.fr: remember + -ing = se souvenir d'avoir fait.

say: I remember meeting him at a party years ago.

question: It's no use ___ about it.
fr: Ça ne sert à rien de s'en plaindre.

explain.fr: It's no use + -ing.

say: It's no use complaining about it.

question: I can't afford ___ a new car.
fr: Je n'ai pas les moyens d'acheter une voiture neuve.

explain.fr: afford + to + verbe.

say: I can't afford to buy a new car.

explain.fr: let + personne + verbe de base (sans to).

question: My parents made me ___ my room.
fr: Mes parents m'ont fait ranger ma chambre.

explain.fr: make + personne + verbe de base.

say: My parents made me clean my room.

question: She ___ be at home. Her lights are on.
fr: Elle doit être chez elle. Ses lumières sont allumées.

explain.fr: Déduction quasi certaine : must.

say: She must be at home. Her lights are on.

question: He ___ be at work. I've just seen him in the park.
fr: Il ne peut pas être au travail. Je viens de le voir au parc.

Scientists say that recycling helps, but the best solution is to use less plastic in the first place.
